title: Notice of a Change to Contractual Terms (Corporate Travel Programmes)
content:
The agency advises the company in writing before it changes any contractual term of a programme held under the Corporate Travel Programmes, and the change takes effect no earlier than the date stated in the notice.

Where the company does not accept a contractual change it may end the agreement at the date the change takes effect without the early exit charge.

## The notice and the two courses open to the company

| Position | Consequence under this clause |
| --- | --- |
| A contractual term is to change | Written notice reaches the company before the change |
| The notice states a date | The change takes effect no earlier than that date |
| The company accepts the change | The programme continues on the changed term from the date the change takes effect |
| The company does not accept the change | It may end the agreement at the date the change takes effect, and the early exit charge does not fall due on that ending |

## Reading the clause

- The date in the notice is a floor on when the change bites, not a ceiling: the change takes effect no earlier than that date.
- The relief from the early exit charge attaches to an ending at the date the change takes effect, and it arises from the company's not accepting a contractual change.
- The notice is written, and it precedes the change rather than reporting it afterwards.
